## Overview

::: {.callout-note}
### Slide Navigation
The interactive lecture slides are built with Quarto and Reveal.js. Use arrow keys (`←`, `→` or `Space`) to navigate slides, `F` for fullscreen, and `O` for slide overview mode.
:::

[Quizzes — check your understanding](quizzes.qmd){.course-button}

## Lecture Schedule & Materials

PDF and PPTX are static copies of the slides. PPTX preserves the layout as images; individual text and diagrams are not separately editable. Use HTML for interactive content.
